faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Ph.D. Position at BITS Pilani is 20 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Ph.D. Position in the Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani recruitment drive. This is a full-time government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position?
faq.answer: The application mode for the BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Ph.D. Position at BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Ph.D. Position is 28 years. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Tech. / M.E. / B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science / Information Technology or related disciplines from a recognized university with an aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA of 6.5 or above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Ph.D. Position at BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Ph.D. Position will receive a salary of Rs. 48100 Per Month. This is a competitive stipend for a research position.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position Recruitment 2026. Applications are free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Ph.D. Position at BITS Pilani involves two main stages: shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job location for the BITS Pilani Ph.D. Position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Ph.D. Position is Hyderabad, Telangana. BITS Pilani's Hyderabad campus is where the research work will be conducted.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website for BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: The official website for BITS Pilani Hyderabad campus, where you can find more details, is https://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/hyderabad. You can also find the link in the Important Links section.
